title: Quantics Elytra Swap
description: Swap between your chestplate and Elytra with a single keybind.
body:
# Quantics Elytra Swap

![Swap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/702639c5456c82c1bce4296f23d65e0670edb040.png)

Quantics Elytra Swap is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that makes switching between your chestplate and Elytra fast, simple and reliable.

## ✨ Features

- ⚡ One-key Elytra swap
- ⌨️ Fully configurable keybind
- 🪶 Lightweight and optimized
- 🌐 Client-side only
- 🎮 Easy to use

## 📦 Compatibility

- ✅ Fabric
- ✅ Client-side
- ✅ No server installation required

## 🚀 Why Quantics?

Quantics Elytra Swap focuses on doing one thing well.

No unnecessary features, no complicated setup, just a fast and reliable Elytra swap.

## 🔮 Planned Features

- Multiplayer compatibility mode
- Smooth swap animation
- Configuration screen
- Additional customization options

![Anim](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a8b9c2d6161b42a7bdf3d8682a1105d0303084a.gif)
